title: Date Picker Design Best Practices
summary: This reel demonstrates how to optimize date pickers for efficiency and accessibility. It covers the use of presets, range highlighting, multi-month views, keyboard shortcuts, and mobile-specific layouts.

transcript.text: Presets cover 90% of cases. Today, yesterday, last 7 days, last 30 days, last quarter. Custom range for the rest.
Highlight the range. Hover paints a preview. Click once for start, click again for end. Drag the edges to refine.
Show two months side-by-side. Ranges cross months. Don't make users click next four times. Three months on wide screens.
Arrows move the cursor. Type the date directly. Enter validates, escape kills. Page up jumps a month, shift page up jumps a year.
Mobile is not a popover. Full-screen sheet. Calendar scrolls vertically. Today stays at the top. Big confirm button at the bottom.
Follow for more UI systems. Save this for your next form.
